h1: Anda Ramkhamhaeng By St James — Practical 3-Star on Ramkhamhaeng Road, Steps from ARL Hua Mak and The Mall
intro: If you need a reliable base in Bangkok's Ramkhamhaeng-Hua Mak neighbourhood — clean rooms, straightforward service, and a location that genuinely connects you to the city — Anda Ramkhamhaeng By St James delivers exactly that. This 3-star, 120-room hotel at 803 Ramkhamhaeng Road, Hua Mak, Bang Kapi was renovated in 2025 and sits within reach of the Airport Rail Link Hua Mak station (A4), getting you to Suvarnabhumi Airport in about 27 minutes, and the MRT Yellow Line linking Lat Phrao to Samrong. Ramkhamhaeng University, ABAC Hua Mak, The Mall Life Store Ramkhamhaeng, and Rajamangala National Stadium are all within a short ride. The hotel also offers free parking, a fitness centre, and an on-site restaurant. Rooms start from approximately ฿600/night, with a guest score of 8.1 from 279 reviews.

body.html: Overview — who stays here and why — Anda Ramkhamhaeng By St James draws a clear core audience: business travellers with meetings in the Ramkhamhaeng corridor, families visiting students at Ramkhamhaeng University or ABAC Hua Mak, concert-goers at Rajamangala National Stadium, and anyone who needs a clean, affordable Bangkok base with direct, fast access to Suvarnabhumi Airport via the Airport Rail Link. With 120 rooms and a 3-star rating — rooms freshened up in a 2025 renovation — the hotel is mid-size by local standards: consistent enough to deliver reliable service, compact enough to avoid the impersonality of a large chain. A guest score of 8.1 across 279 verified reviews signals that most people leave having received what they paid for.

Location and getting around — The hotel sits at 803 Ramkhamhaeng Road in the Hua Mak sub-district of Bang Kapi — a neighbourhood shaped by student life, local markets, halal eateries, and functional everyday Bangkok rather than tourist landmarks. Key transport links: ARL Hua Mak (A4) connects directly to Suvarnabhumi Airport in around 27 minutes without a transfer, one of the most practical airport links available from this part of the city. MRT Yellow Line, Hua Mak station runs from Lat Phrao through to Samrong, covering Bangkok's eastern arc efficiently. Ramkhamhaeng University — one of Thailand's largest open universities — lies within a couple of kilometres. Rajamangala National Stadium, Bangkok's major concert and sports venue, is a Grab ride of about 7–10 minutes. The Mall Life Store Ramkhamhaeng provides department-store shopping, cinema screens, and a large food court within easy reach. One honest note: if your goal is walking to the BTS network or Sukhumvit, you will need a transport connection. This is the right base for travellers with a specific reason to be here — not for those prioritising central-Bangkok walkability.
"Very clean room, comfortable bed and a big bathroom with a proper hot shower. Great for catching the ARL early morning. Surprisingly good for the price."

Rooms and facilities — The hotel's 120 rooms — renovated in 2025 — span Superior Double, Superior Twin, Deluxe Double and Deluxe Twin categories. Every room includes air conditioning, flat-screen TV, mini-fridge, electric kettle, free Wi-Fi, and a private bathroom with shower. Verified guests praise cleanliness consistently: linen changed regularly, rooms tidy even in lower-floor units. A fitness centre is available at no extra charge, popular with business travellers wanting an early workout. Free parking for all in-house guests is frequently mentioned in reviews — a genuine practical advantage for visitors driving in from the provinces who need secure, no-cost overnight parking in Bangkok. No swimming pool is offered, which is standard for 3-star hotels at this price point in the area.

Dining and service — The on-site restaurant serves breakfast and main meals, with a straightforward buffet breakfast and a Thai-international menu through the day. Reviews describe the breakfast as functional rather than memorable — adequate for a workday start but limited in variety for longer stays. Front desk operates around the clock; staff are noted for English communication ability and reliability when arranging taxis or giving local directions. For evening meals, Ramkhamhaeng-Hua Mak offers genuine variety: street-food vendors, neighbourhood Thai restaurants, and halal options within a short walk or ride, all at prices well below tourist-area equivalents.

What real guests say — Across 279 reviews on Booking.com, Agoda and Trip.com, the picture is consistent. Praise focuses on: cleanliness above expectations for the price, friendly and responsive front desk, free parking valued especially by domestic travellers, and the ARL Hua Mak connection for airport convenience. Criticisms centre on: Wi-Fi signal inconsistency in some rooms, occasional sound transfer from corridors in certain room positions, limited breakfast variety, the lack of a pool, and some guests noting elevator odour that needs attention. None of these are unusual for a 3-star at this price; they are worth knowing to calibrate expectations.
"Location is ideal for the ARL — 27 minutes to Suvarnabhumi is genuinely useful. Room clean, bed comfortable, staff helpful. Wi-Fi a bit patchy but overall solid value."

Price and value — Standard Superior rooms typically run approximately ฿600–900/night outside peak periods, with Deluxe rooms adding a modest premium. Trip.com shows rates from around USD 17 per night at off-peak points, with an average closer to USD 39. During major events at Rajamangala Stadium, prices across the neighbourhood rise noticeably — book early and secure a free-cancellation rate as soon as plans are confirmed. For what the hotel provides — clean renovated rooms, free parking, fitness access, an in-house restaurant, and an unmatched ARL connection — the 8.1 score reflects consistent, honest delivery of 3-star value.

honestSummary: Anda Ramkhamhaeng By St James works well for travellers with a clear reason to be in the Ramkhamhaeng-Hua Mak area: university visits, business meetings, concerts at Rajamangala, or a convenient overnight before an early Suvarnabhumi flight via the ARL. It is not the pick for those planning daily excursions to Sukhumvit or the old city — but for its target audience, the 8.1 score across 279 reviews reflects honest, consistent delivery.

tips.title: ARL Hua Mak — 27 min to the airport
tips.body: ARL Hua Mak (A4) is a short Grab ride from the hotel. Board at Hua Mak and arrive at Suvarnabhumi in around 27 minutes — far cheaper and often faster than a taxi in morning traffic. Ideal for early departures or late-night arrivals.

tips.title: Book early for Rajamangala event nights
tips.body: Prices across the Ramkhamhaeng area rise sharply when Rajamangala Stadium hosts major concerts or sporting events. Confirm your dates early, choose a free-cancellation rate, and lock it in before inventory tightens.

tips.title: Free parking — register at check-in
tips.body: Complimentary parking is available for all in-house guests. Register your number plate with the front desk when you arrive. A genuine bonus if you are driving in from outside Bangkok.

tips.title: Pack a backup SIM if you need solid Wi-Fi
tips.body: Wi-Fi is free in all rooms, but some guests report variable signal strength depending on floor and room position. If you have video meetings or need reliable connectivity throughout your stay, keep a Thai SIM with data as a backup.

faqTitle: FAQ — Anda Ramkhamhaeng By St James Bangkok

faq.q: Where is Anda Ramkhamhaeng By St James and what is nearby?
faq.a: The hotel is at 803 Ramkhamhaeng Road, Hua Mak, Bang Kapi, Bangkok 10240. Nearby: ARL Hua Mak station (A4, ~27 min to Suvarnabhumi Airport), MRT Yellow Line Hua Mak station, Ramkhamhaeng University, Rajamangala National Stadium, and The Mall Life Store Ramkhamhaeng.

faq.q: What is the price range at Anda Ramkhamhaeng By St James?
faq.a: Standard Superior rooms start from approximately ฿600–900/night in normal periods. Deluxe rooms run around ฿800–850. Prices rise significantly during major events at Rajamangala Stadium — book early and choose a free-cancellation rate.

faq.q: Does Anda Ramkhamhaeng By St James have free parking?
faq.a: Yes — complimentary parking is available for all hotel guests. Register your vehicle at check-in. This is one of the most frequently praised features in guest reviews, particularly useful for visitors driving in from outside Bangkok.

faq.q: How do I get from Suvarnabhumi Airport to Anda Ramkhamhaeng By St James?
faq.a: Take the Airport Rail Link (ARL) from Suvarnabhumi to Hua Mak station (A4) — approximately 27 minutes. From the station, take a Grab or motorcycle taxi for around 5 minutes to the hotel at 803 Ramkhamhaeng Road.

faq.q: Who is Anda Ramkhamhaeng By St James best suited for?
faq.a: Best for business travellers in the Ramkhamhaeng area, families visiting students at Ramkhamhaeng University or ABAC Hua Mak, concert-goers at Rajamangala Stadium, and anyone who wants a clean, affordable Bangkok base with free parking and convenient ARL access to the airport.
